- **`/etc/hosts`** — Local hostname resolution; removing it can break name lookups for localhost and any custom host mappings.
- **`/etc/resolv.conf`** — DNS resolver configuration; removing it will likely break all DNS resolution (no internet by hostname).
- **`/etc/fstab`** — Filesystem mount table; removing it can prevent the system from booting properly or mounting filesystems on next boot.

```sh
cp /etc/hosts /workspace/system_backup/
cp /etc/resolv.conf /workspace/system_backup/
cp /etc/fstab /workspace/system_backup/
```

Or preserving metadata:

```sh

```
